component: Virtual-folder deletion command and event phases

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original command port changes the message-tab and message-window actions while retaining waits for both DeleteOrMoveMsgCompleted and DeleteOrMoveMsgFailed. The exact historical promiseFolderEvent receiver resolves on a matching event, so either event can fulfill Promise.any. That wait ending does not itself assert successful deletion; the display checks follow separately. Fixed accepted source later uses performDelete with only Completed versus a rejecting timeout. Keep those completion phases distinct.
title: The virtual-folder command port keeps failure notifications as wait outcomes
